summary: TOP 100 CHATGPT PHOTO EDITING PROMPTS 100 COPY-PASTE PROMPTS • 10 PARTS • EXAMPLES INCLUDED
raw:
SADDY TECH X • PHOTO EDITING PROMPTS
TOP 100 CHATGPT
PHOTO EDITING PROMPTS
SADDY TECH X
100 COPY-PASTE PROMPTS • 10 PARTS • EXAMPLES INCLUDED
PORTRAITS • BACKGROUNDS • CINEMATIC EFFECTS • PRODUCT PHOTOS • RESTORATION •
SOCIAL MEDIA
HOW TO USE
1. Upload your photo to ChatGPT.
2. Copy a prompt from this PDF.
3. Replace text in [brackets] with your desired details.
4. Ask ChatGPT to keep the person’s identity and important details unchanged where needed.
TIP: Results can vary. Review every edit and specify what must stay unchanged.
TEACH • CREATE • EMPOWER
SADDY TECH X • PHOTO EDITING PROMPTS
PART 1 — PROMPTS 1–10
1. Cinematic Portrait
Example / Input: Portrait photo with warm movie-style lighting
Copy-paste prompt: Turn this portrait into a cinematic photo with dramatic lighting, rich contrast, a softly blurred background,
realistic skin texture, and the same face and identity.
2. Pencil Sketch
Example / Input: Portrait converted into a pencil drawing
Copy-paste prompt: Convert this photo into a detailed graphite pencil sketch on white paper, preserving the subject’s facial
features, pose, and proportions.
3. Anime Style
Example / Input: Portrait in anime illustration style
Copy-paste prompt: Transform this photo into a polished anime-style illustration with expressive eyes, clean line art, vibrant
colors, and the same hairstyle and pose.
4. 3D Cartoon
Example / Input: Portrait as a 3D animated character
Copy-paste prompt: Create a high-quality 3D cartoon version of this photo with soft studio lighting, detailed textures, and
recognizable facial features.
5. Toy Figure
Example / Input: Person as a boxed collectible figure
Copy-paste prompt: Turn the person in this photo into a realistic collectible toy figure inside a clear display box, with miniature
accessories and studio product lighting.
6. Miniature World
Example / Input: Person as a miniature in a garden
Copy-paste prompt: Make the subject look like a tiny miniature in a realistic oversized environment, with tilt-shift depth of field
and believable scale.
7. Polaroid Look
Example / Input: Portrait with a retro instant-photo frame
Copy-paste prompt: Give this photo a vintage instant-film Polaroid look with soft flash, subtle grain, faded tones, and a white
photo border.
8. Movie Poster
Example / Input: Portrait transformed into an action movie poster
Copy-paste prompt: Create a dramatic cinematic movie poster using this photo, with atmospheric lighting, bold composition, and
space for a title; keep the person recognizable.
SADDY TECH X • PHOTO EDITING PROMPTS
9. Professional Headshot
Example / Input: Casual portrait into a professional headshot
Copy-paste prompt: Convert this photo into a professional passport or LinkedIn-style headshot with a neutral background,
balanced lighting, and natural facial details.
10. Yearbook Portrait
Example / Input: Student-style yearbook portrait
Copy-paste prompt: Give this photo a classic school yearbook portrait style with a simple studio background, soft lighting, and
natural colors.
SADDY TECH X • PHOTO EDITING PROMPTS
PART 2 — PROMPTS 11–20
11. Future Self
Example / Input: Young adult shown at an older age
Copy-paste prompt: Create a realistic age-progressed version of this person, showing natural aging while preserving
recognizable identity and facial structure.
12. Career Transformation
Example / Input: Person portrayed as a doctor in a clinic
Copy-paste prompt: Change the outfit and setting to show this person as a [profession], with realistic professional clothing and
an appropriate workplace; keep their face unchanged.
13. Fantasy World
Example / Input: Portrait in a fantasy castle landscape
Copy-paste prompt: Place the subject in a magical fantasy world with a grand castle, glowing particles, atmospheric clouds, and
cinematic realism.
14. Product Photography
Example / Input: Watch photographed for an online store
Copy-paste prompt: Turn this product photo into a premium commercial product shoot with clean studio lighting, realistic
shadows, crisp details, and a polished background.
15. Four Seasons
Example / Input: Same park portrait across four seasons
Copy-paste prompt: Create a four-season comparison using the same scene, showing spring, summer, autumn, and winter
while keeping the subject and composition consistent.
16. Double Exposure
Example / Input: Portrait blended with a forest
Copy-paste prompt: Create an artistic double-exposure effect blending the subject’s silhouette with [landscape/city/forest], with
clean edges and balanced contrast.
17. Remove Object
Example / Input: Remove a distracting bag from the ground
Copy-paste prompt: Remove the unwanted [object] from this photo and naturally reconstruct the background, preserving all
other details.
18. Add Object
Example / Input: Add a dog beside a seated person
Copy-paste prompt: Add a realistic [object] to this photo at the specified location, matching perspective, lighting, scale, and
shadows.
SADDY TECH X • PHOTO EDITING PROMPTS
19. Change Outfit
Example / Input: Casual clothes changed to a formal suit
Copy-paste prompt: Change the person’s clothing to [outfit/style], with realistic fabric folds and lighting; keep the face, pose,
body proportions, and background unchanged.
20. Change Location
Example / Input: Portrait placed near the Eiffel Tower
Copy-paste prompt: Place the subject at [destination/location], matching the scene’s perspective, natural lighting, and shadows
while keeping the person recognizable.
SADDY TECH X • PHOTO EDITING PROMPTS
PART 3 — PROMPTS 21–30
21. Background Removal
Example / Input: Product cut out on transparency
Copy-paste prompt: Remove the background cleanly and keep only the main subject with accurate edges, transparent
background, and no unwanted halos.
22. Replace Background
Example / Input: Indoor portrait placed in a garden
Copy-paste prompt: Replace the current background with [new background], matching light direction, perspective, color
temperature, and realistic shadows.
23. Blur Background
Example / Input: Portrait with soft bokeh background
Copy-paste prompt: Apply a natural portrait-mode background blur while keeping the subject sharp, with realistic depth of field
and clean hair edges.
24. Change Hairstyle
Example / Input: Short hair changed to a wavy hairstyle
Copy-paste prompt: Change the hairstyle to [hairstyle], making the hairline, texture, and lighting realistic while preserving the
person’s face and expression.
25. Add Sunglasses
Example / Input: Black sunglasses added to a portrait
Copy-paste prompt: Add realistic [style] sunglasses to the subject, matching face angle, reflections, scale, and lighting without
changing other facial features.
26. Remove Text
Example / Input: Remove a date label from a photo
Copy-paste prompt: Remove the text or watermark-like overlay specified by the user from this image and naturally fill the area,
preserving the original scene.
27. Add Text
Example / Input: Add an inspirational quote to a landscape
Copy-paste prompt: Add the exact text “[YOUR TEXT]” to this image in a stylish, readable font with suitable placement, contrast,
and perspective; do not alter the subject.
28. Black and White
Example / Input: Classic monochrome portrait
Copy-paste prompt: Convert this photo to a rich black-and-white image with balanced highlights, deep but detailed shadows,
and natural skin texture.
SADDY TECH X • PHOTO EDITING PROMPTS
29. Warm Color Grade
Example / Input: Warm sunset-style portrait
Copy-paste prompt: Apply a warm cinematic color grade with golden highlights and balanced shadows, keeping skin tones
natural and preserving the original subject.
30. Cool Color Grade
Example / Input: Cool-toned city portrait
Copy-paste prompt: Apply a cool blue cinematic color grade with controlled contrast and natural skin tones, keeping the image
realistic.
SADDY TECH X • PHOTO EDITING PROMPTS
PART 4 — PROMPTS 31–40
31. Sunset Effect
Example / Input: Outdoor portrait at sunset
Copy-paste prompt: Change the lighting to a beautiful golden-hour sunset with warm highlights, realistic sky colors, and
matching light on the subject.
32. Rain Effect
Example / Input: Street scene during rain
Copy-paste prompt: Add realistic rainfall, wet surfaces, and subtle reflections while preserving the original composition and
making the effect believable.
33. Snow Effect
Example / Input: Park scene in snowfall
Copy-paste prompt: Add natural falling snow and a light winter atmosphere, with realistic snow accumulation where appropriate
and consistent lighting.
34. HD Enhancement
Example / Input: Soft photo enhanced for clarity
Copy-paste prompt: Improve image clarity and resolution, reduce noise, recover natural detail, and preserve the original face,
colors, and composition without over-sharpening.
35. Vintage Film
Example / Input: Portrait with retro film tones
Copy-paste prompt: Give the image a vintage 1970s film look with subtle grain, slightly faded colors, gentle contrast, and
authentic analog character.
36. Neon Glow
Example / Input: Night portrait with blue neon glow
Copy-paste prompt: Add tasteful neon lighting in [color] around selected edges and background elements, with realistic light spill
while keeping the subject clear.
37. Shadow Enhancement

MASTER PROMPT — CONSISTENT CHARACTER
SHEET
Use this template when you want to create a new character or keep the same design across multiple images.
Create a premium 3D cartoon character of [CHARACTER TYPE] with [COLORS, FEATURES, OUTFIT
OR ACCESSORIES]. Keep the character design consistent in every image: same face, eye shape, colors,
markings, hairstyle/fur/feathers/scales, outfit, accessories, body proportions and silhouette. Show a clean
character turnaround sheet with full-body front view, side view and back view, followed by a row of
expressions: happy, winking, surprised, angry, laughing and sleepy. Use high-quality 3D animated-film
rendering, appealing expressive eyes, detailed materials, soft cinematic studio lighting, gentle contact
shadows, sharp focus, clean uncluttered light background, evenly spaced views, same scale and camera
angle. No extra characters, no duplicate limbs, no cropped feet, no watermark, no random text, no logo
unless requested.
CONSISTENCY TIPS
1. Reuse the exact character description every time.
2. Keep the same reference image, seed, model, and aspect ratio when your tool supports them.
3. Change only the pose, camera angle, or expression—not the character’s core features.
4. For a poster, generate the character sheet first and add headings and prompt text as a separate design layer.

PART 1 — CUTE CLASSICS

FOX
Create a cute 3D cartoon fox character with bright orange fur, a cream muzzle and chest, oversized
expressive eyes, a fluffy tail, and a friendly playful smile. Show a clean character turnaround with front,
side, and back views, plus happy, winking, surprised, angry, and sleepy expressions. Premium
animated-film quality, soft studio lighting, detailed fur, consistent proportions, full body, clean light
background, no extra characters, no text.

paws, and a gentle smile. Show front, side, and back views and a row of expressions: happy, laughing,
surprised, angry, and winking. Keep the same face, fur color, body proportions, and accessories in every
view. High-quality 3D render, soft shadows, detailed fur, clean light background, full body, no text.
RABBIT
Create an adorable 3D cartoon rabbit with soft white fur, long pink inner ears, a tiny nose, round cheeks,
and large bright eyes. Include front, side, and back turnaround views and happy, winking, laughing,
surprised, and sleepy expressions. Keep anatomy and colors consistent, detailed soft fur, gentle cinematic
lighting, full body, clean studio background, no text.

SADDY TECH X
TOP 10 PRODUCT
ADVERTISING AI PROMPTS
PART 1-10 | COMPLETE COPY-AND-PASTE GUIDE
10 product categories • 10 separate prompts • 10 worked examples
HOW TO USE THESE PROMPTS
This PDF contains 10 separate prompts. Each prompt is designed for one product category. You can use the same
prompt with your own product photo by replacing the example product with your uploaded image.
STEP-BY-STEP METHOD
1. Choose a product. Select the prompt that matches your product, such as skincare, coffee, juice, earbuds, a
smartwatch, a bottle, a backpack, shoes, or headphones.
SADDY TECH X  |  AI PROMPT COLLECTION
2. Take a clear photo. Use a front-facing product photo with good lighting. Keep the full product, logo, label, and
packaging visible. A plain background works best.
3. Open ChatGPT. Start a new chat and upload your product photo using the attachment button.
4. Copy the matching prompt. Copy the complete prompt from this PDF and paste it into the chat after uploading
your photo.
5. Generate the poster. Ask ChatGPT to create the advertisement. If the first result has mistakes, ask for a correction.
6. Check the final design. Check the brand name, product label, spelling, claims, and product shape before
publishing.
IMPORTANT TIPS
• Use your own product photo or a photo you have permission to use.
• Do not ask AI to invent product features, prices, certifications, or health claims.
• AI may misspell small packaging text. For an exact label, add the original logo or label again in an editor.
• If you want a different background, change only the background direction in the prompt.
• For Instagram feed posts, ask for a vertical 4:5 layout. For Stories or Reels covers, ask for 9:16.
BEST RESULT TIP: Upload one product photo at a time. Keep the product image as the main reference and clearly
ask the AI to preserve the original packaging, logo, shape, and visible text.
WHAT DOES INPUT → OUTPUT MEAN?
INPUT: Your original product photo.
OUTPUT: The finished advertising poster created by AI using your photo and prompt.
PROMPT: The written instruction that tells AI how to design the advertisement.
SADDY TECH X  |  AI PROMPT COLLECTION

Upload a clear photo of a sunscreen stick. Example: a red or pink strawberry sunscreen stick with its original label
visible.

stick. Keep the original product shape, cap, packaging, brand logo, label, colours, and all visible details as close to the
reference as possible. Place the product prominently in the centre. Create a fresh strawberry-inspired background with
realistic strawberries, sliced fruit, green leaves, soft cream textures, and subtle water droplets. Use large, bold editorial
typography with the headline “STRAWBERRY DEW” and a smaller supporting line “SUNSCREEN STICK”. Add clean
product-ad styling, realistic shadows, soft studio lighting, and a balanced premium composition. Do not invent SPF ratings,
certifications, ingredients, or benefits that are not visible in the reference. Vertical 4:5 format, high resolution, suitable for
social media.
How to use: Upload your own product photo, copy this prompt, paste it into ChatGPT, and generate your poster. Replace any example
